title: Service Billing Office Basis: Invoicing, Credits and Drift Complaints on Custom Application and Field Services
content:
Acre charges under Custom Application and Field Services are invoiced to the member's service account on the programme's terms in calendar days from the invoice date. That account carries the money owed for custom application work: acre billing and surcharges raise it, and credits issued reduce it.

**When a credit is written.** A credit is written where a pass was billed for more acres than the guidance record shows, where a pass was run on the wrong field, or where rework is done inside the programme's free rework period on acres within the programme's rework allowance.

**What a credit attaches to.** A credit is written against the work order the charge was raised on, so a member disputing two passes gets two credits, and never against the account as a whole.

**Rework outside the allowance.** Rework beyond the allowance, or after the free period, is billed as a fresh pass at the plan's rate.

**Drift complaints.** A drift complaint is taken within the programme's complaint window counted in calendar days from the work date, and a complaint outside that window is not taken at the desk at all. The work date is the date of the pass as the work order records it, identified by the work order number the complaint concerns, and it is the record rather than the member's recollection that fixes it. The window is measured before the complaint is taken.

**What a drift complaint settles.** Whether a drift complaint results in a credit, and how much, is settled by the cooperative's insurer and the state's pesticide authority rather than by any rule here, and the desk records the complaint and says so.

## The complaint window at its boundary

The count runs in calendar days from the work date, the work date itself counting as day zero, and the comparison is that the complaint must fall not later than the end of the window. A complaint on the last day of the window is inside it.

| Programme window | Complaint raised | Position |
|---|---|---|
| 14 calendar days | on the 14th day after the work date | inside the window, and the complaint is taken |
| 14 calendar days | on the 15th day after the work date | outside the window, and the complaint is not taken at the desk |
| 7 calendar days | on the 7th day after the work date | inside the window, and the complaint is taken |
| 7 calendar days | on the 8th day after the work date | outside the window, and the complaint is not taken at the desk |
